source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 3 (PDF 54-74), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Circular and Rotational Motion) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 When an object moves in a circular path with constant speed, its velocity is:
(Jab koi jism circular path (gol raaste) par yaksaan speed se chalta hai to us ki velocity:)

options.text: magnitude aur simt dono mein constant
constant nahi, kyunke simt badalti rehti hai

blocks.explanation: Gol raaste par simt (direction) musalsal badalti hai; velocity vector hai, is liye velocity constant nahi rehti (3.1).

book_ref.quote: When objects move in circular paths, their direction is continuously changing.

blocks.prompt:
2 Which one of the following is given in the chapter as a familiar example of circular motion?
(In mein se kaun si cheez chapter mein circular motion (gol harkat) ki aam misaal ke taur par di gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter mein satellites, Zameen ki orbital aur spin motion, mor par car aur dhaage se ghumaya gaya pathar misalein hain (3.1).

book_ref.quote: Satellites moving in circular orbits around the Earth, orbital and spin motion of the Earth itself

blocks.prompt:
3 The angle subtended at the centre of a circle by an arc whose length is equal to the radius of the circle is:
(Daire ke markaz par us arc (qaus) se banne wala angle jis ki lambai radius ke barabar ho, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar arc AB ki lambai radius r ke barabar ho to markaz par angle aik radian hota hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: then the angle is called one radian

blocks.prompt:
4 The SI unit of angular measurement is the:
(Angle naapne ki SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radian angle naapne ki SI unit hai aur us ka symbol rad hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: It is the SI unit of angular measurement and its symbol is

blocks.prompt:
5 For a particle P moving on a circle at the end of a rod pivoted at O, the axis of rotation:
(O par pivot ki gayi rod ke sire par circle par ghoomne wale particle P ke liye axis of rotation (ghoomne ka mehwar):)

options.text: ghoomne ke plane mein OP ke saath
P se guzarta hai aur OP ke mutawazi hai
P par circle ka tangent hai
O se guzarta hai aur ghoomne ke plane par amoodi hai

blocks.explanation: Axis of rotation pivot O se guzarta hai aur ghoomne ke plane par amoodi (normal) hota hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: The axis of rotation passes through the pivot O and is normal to the plane of rotation.

blocks.prompt:
6 The angle Δθ through which the line OP turns in a time interval Δt is called its:
(Waqt ke waqfe Δt mein line OP jitna angle Δθ ghoomti hai, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Angle Δθ waqfe Δt mein OP ka angular displacement (zaviyai haqeeqi faasla) hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: defines the angular displacement of OP during the time interval

blocks.prompt:
7 Angular displacement is a vector quantity:
(Angular displacement vector quantity kab hota hai?)

options.text: Δθ ki har qeemat ke liye
sirf bohat chhote Δθ ke liye
sirf 2π rad se bare angles ke liye

blocks.explanation: Sirf bohat chhote Δθ ke liye angular displacement vector hota hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: the angular displacement is a vector quantity

blocks.prompt:
8 The angular displacement Δθ is taken as positive when OP rotates:
(Angular displacement Δθ ko positive kab liya jata hai?)

options.text: counter clockwise (ghari ki suiyon ke ulat)

blocks.explanation: Jab OP counter clockwise (ghari ki suiyon ke ulat) ghoome to Δθ positive hota hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: is assigned a positive sign when the sense of rotation of OP is counter clock wise

blocks.prompt:
9 According to the right hand rule, when the fingers of the right hand curl in the direction of rotation, the thumb points in the direction of:
(Right hand rule ke mutabiq jab daayen haath ki ungliyan ghoomne ke rukh mein mudti hain to angootha kis ki simt batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Axis ko pakar kar ungliyan ghoomne ke rukh mein mudein; angootha angular displacement ki simt batata hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: Grasp the axis of rotation in right hand with fingers curling in the direction of rotation

blocks.prompt:
10 The direction of a small angular displacement is:
(Chhote angular displacement ki simt kya hoti hai?)

options.text: radius ke saath markaz ki taraf
radius ke saath markaz se door

blocks.explanation: Δθ ki simt axis of rotation ke saath hoti hai, jo right hand rule se maloom hoti hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: The direction associated with Δθ is along the axis of rotation

blocks.prompt:
11 Which of the following is NOT a unit of angular displacement?
(In mein se kaun si angular displacement ki unit NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Angular displacement degree, revolution aur radian mein naapa jata hai (3.1); metre lambai ki unit hai.

book_ref.quote: Three units are generally used to express angular displacement

blocks.prompt:
12 An arc of length 1.2 m on a circle of radius 0.50 m subtends at the centre an angle of:
(0.50 m radius wale circle par 1.2 m lamba arc markaz par kitna angle banata hai?)

book_ref.quote: Its value in radians (rad) is given as:

blocks.prompt:
13 A point on a wheel of radius 0.40 m turns through 2.5 rad. The arc length it covers is:
(0.40 m radius wale pahiye ka aik point 2.5 rad ghoomta hai. Woh kitna arc tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: S = rθ = 0.40 × 2.5 = 1.0 m (Eq. 3.1, θ radian mein).

book_ref.quote: which subtends an angle θ at the centre of the circle

blocks.prompt:
14 Three revolutions are equal to:
(Teen revolutions (chakkar) kitne radian ke barabar hain?)
blocks.explanation: 1 revolution = 2π rad, is liye 3 rev = 6π rad = 18.8 rad (3.1).

book_ref.quote: the point P covers a distance S = 2πr in one revolution of P

blocks.prompt:
15 An angle of 2.5 rad, expressed in degrees, is about:
(2.5 rad ka angle degrees mein taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Consider an arc of length S of a circle of radius r

blocks.prompt:
16 The rate at which the angular displacement changes with time is called:
(Angular displacement ke waqt ke saath badalne ki sharah (rate) ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Angular velocity (zaviyai raftaar) angular displacement ke waqt ke saath badalne ki sharah hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: defined as the rate at which the angular displacement is changing with time

blocks.prompt:
17 A rod turns through an angular displacement of 30 rad in 6.0 s. Its average angular velocity is:
(Aik rod 6.0 s mein 30 rad ka angular displacement tay karti hai. Us ki average angular velocity kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Very often, we are interested in knowing how fast or how slow a body is rotating.

blocks.prompt:
18 The instantaneous angular velocity is a vector because:
(Instantaneous angular velocity vector kyun hai?)

options.text: yeh rad s⁻¹ mein naapi jati hai
yeh hamesha tangent ke rukh hoti hai
har rotation ka angular displacement bara hota hai
Δt → 0 par angular displacement bohat chhota ho kar vector hota hai

blocks.explanation: Jab Δt sifr ki taraf jata hai to Δθ bohat chhota ho kar vector ban jata hai; is liye Eq. 3.3 wali ω bhi vector hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: So, it would be a vector quantity and the angular velocity as defined by Eq. 3.3 would also be a vector.

blocks.prompt:
19 The direction of angular velocity is:
(Angular velocity ki simt kya hai?)

options.text: gol raaste ke tangent ke saath

blocks.explanation: ω ki simt axis of rotation ke saath hai, right hand rule se (3.1).

book_ref.quote: Its direction is along the axis of rotation and is given by right hand rule as described earlier.

blocks.prompt:
20 The SI unit of angular velocity is:
(Angular velocity ki SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Angular velocity ki SI unit radian per second hai; kabhi rpm bhi istemal hota hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: Angular velocity is measured in radians per second which is the SI unit.

blocks.prompt:
21 A wheel rotates at 120 rpm. Its angular velocity in rad s⁻¹ is about:
(Aik pahiya 120 rpm par ghoomta hai. Us ki angular velocity rad s⁻¹ mein taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Sometimes it is also given in terms of revolution per minute (rpm).

blocks.prompt:
22 A rod makes one complete revolution uniformly in 60 s. Its angular velocity is about:
(Aik rod yaksaan raftaar se 60 s mein aik poora chakkar lagati hai. Us ki angular velocity taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The instantaneous angular velocity ω is the limit of the ratio

blocks.prompt:
23 Angular acceleration is defined as the:
(Angular acceleration ki definition kya hai?)

options.text: angular velocity ki tabdeeli ki sharah
angular displacement ki tabdeeli ki sharah
linear velocity ki tabdeeli ki sharah
angular velocity aur time ka hasil zarb

blocks.explanation: Angular acceleration (zaviyai asraa) angular velocity ki tabdeeli ki sharah hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: We define angular acceleration as the rate of change of angular velocity.

blocks.prompt:
24 The angular velocity of a fan increases from 4.0 rad s⁻¹ to 16 rad s⁻¹ in 3.0 s. Its average angular acceleration is:
(Pankhe ki angular velocity 3.0 s mein 4.0 rad s⁻¹ se 16 rad s⁻¹ ho jati hai. Us ki average angular acceleration kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: When we switch on an electric fan, we notice that its angular velocity goes on increasing.

blocks.prompt:
25 The unit of angular acceleration is:
(Angular acceleration ki unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Angular acceleration rad s⁻² mein naapi jati hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: Angular acceleration is expressed in rad s

blocks.prompt:
26 The direction of angular acceleration is:
(Angular acceleration ki simt kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Angular acceleration vector hai aur us ki simt axis of rotation ke saath hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: The angular acceleration is also a vector quantity whose magnitude is given by Eq. 3.5

blocks.prompt:
27 For a rotating rigid body, the perpendicular OP dropped from a point P of the body on the axis of rotation is called the:
(Ghoomte hue rigid body ke point P se axis of rotation par giraya gaya amood OP kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: P se axis par amood OP reference line kehlata hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: usually referred as the reference line

blocks.prompt:
28 The rotation of a whole rigid body can be described by the rotation of its reference line OP because:
(Poore rigid body ki rotation ko us ki reference line OP ki rotation se kyun bayan kiya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: OP ki linear speed jism ke har point jitni hai
OP axis of rotation ke saath hai
OP jism wali angular velocity aur angular acceleration se ghoomti hai

blocks.explanation: Jism ke saath OP bhi usi angular velocity aur angular acceleration se ghoomti hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: As the body rotates, line OP also rotates with the same angular velocity and angular acceleration.

blocks.prompt:
29 The linear velocity of a point on a rotating body is directed:
(Ghoomte jism ke kisi point ki linear velocity ki simt kya hoti hai?)

options.text: us point par circle ke tangent ke saath
radius ke saath markaz se door

blocks.explanation: P ki velocity hamesha us point par circle ke tangent ke saath hoti hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: its direction is always along the tangent to the circle at that point

blocks.prompt:
30 The linear velocity of a point moving on a circle is also called:
(Circle par chalne wale point ki linear velocity ko aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh hamesha tangent ke saath hoti hai, is liye ise tangential velocity kehte hain (3.1).

book_ref.quote: the linear velocity of the point P is also known as tangential velocity

blocks.prompt:
31 A point is 0.30 m from the axis of a body rotating at 20 rad s⁻¹. Its linear speed is:
(Aik point 20 rad s⁻¹ se ghoomte jism ke axis se 0.30 m door hai. Us ki linear speed kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Imagine a point P in the rigid body at a perpendicular distance r from the axis of rotation.

blocks.prompt:
32 A disc has angular acceleration 8.0 rad s⁻². The tangential acceleration of a point 0.25 m from its axis is:
(Aik disc ki angular acceleration 8.0 rad s⁻² hai. Axis se 0.25 m door point ki tangential acceleration kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Using Eq. 3.7 it can be shown that the two accelerations are related by

blocks.prompt:
33 Two points of a rigid body rotating about a fixed axis are at different distances from the axis. At any instant they have the same:
(Fixed axis par ghoomte rigid body ke do points axis se mukhtalif faaslon par hain. Kisi bhi lamhe un ki kaun si cheez aik jaisi hai?)

options.text: raaste par tay kiya gaya faasla

blocks.explanation: Fixed axis par ghoomte rigid body ke sab points ka angular displacement, angular speed aur angular acceleration aik jaisa hota hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: do have the same angular displacement, angular speed and angular acceleration at any instant

blocks.prompt:
34 Two points A and B are on a rotating disc; A is twice as far from the axis as B. The linear speed of A is:
(Ghoomti disc par do points A aur B hain; A axis se B ke muqable mein dugna door hai. A ki linear speed:)
blocks.explanation: Dono ki ω aik hai; v = rω, is liye r dugna hone se speed dugni (Eq. 3.7).

book_ref.quote: points that are at different distances from the axis do not have the same speed or acceleration

blocks.prompt:
35 The angular equations of motion are obtained from the linear ones by replacing S, v and a by:
(Linear equations mein S, v aur a ko kis se badalne par angular equations milti hain?)
blocks.explanation: S, v, a ki jagah θ, ω, α rakhne se angular equations milti hain (3.1).

book_ref.quote: exactly analogous to those in linear motion if θ, ω and α be replaced by S, v and a, respectively

blocks.prompt:
36 The angular equations of motion (3.9 to 3.11) hold only when:
(Angular equations of motion (3.9 se 3.11) sirf kab sahi hain?)

options.text: sab points ki linear speed barabar ho

blocks.explanation: Yeh sirf tab sahi hain jab axis fixed ho, taake sab angular vectors ki simt aik ho aur unhein scalars ki tarah liya ja sake (3.1).

book_ref.quote: hold true only in the case when the axis of rotation is fixed, so that all the angular vectors have the same direction

blocks.prompt:
37 A wheel starts at 5.0 rad s⁻¹ and has a uniform angular acceleration of 2.0 rad s⁻². Its angular velocity after 6.0 s is:
(Aik pahiya 5.0 rad s⁻¹ se shuru hota hai aur us ki yaksaan angular acceleration 2.0 rad s⁻² hai. 6.0 s baad us ki angular velocity kitni hogi?)

book_ref.quote: Given below are angular equations together with their linear counterparts.

blocks.prompt:
38 A disc starts with ωᵢ = 2.0 rad s⁻¹ and uniform α = 3.0 rad s⁻². The angle it turns through in 4.0 s is:
(Aik disc ωᵢ = 2.0 rad s⁻¹ aur yaksaan α = 3.0 rad s⁻² se shuru hoti hai. 4.0 s mein woh kitna angle ghoomti hai?)

book_ref.quote: As the other equations of linear motion were obtained by algebraic manipulation of these equations

blocks.prompt:
39 A wheel speeds up uniformly from 10 rad s⁻¹ to 20 rad s⁻¹ with α = 5.0 rad s⁻². The angle turned is:
(Aik pahiya α = 5.0 rad s⁻² se 10 rad s⁻¹ se 20 rad s⁻¹ tak yaksaan tez hota hai. Kitna angle ghooma?)

book_ref.quote: Hence, they can be manipulated as scalars.

blocks.prompt:
40 A fan rotating at 5.0 rev s⁻¹ is switched off and stops uniformly in 10 s. The number of revolutions it makes before stopping is:
(5.0 rev s⁻¹ par ghoomta pankha band karne par 10 s mein yaksaan tor par ruk jata hai. Rukne se pehle kitne chakkar lagata hai?)

book_ref.quote: Assuming deceleration to be uniform, find its value.

blocks.prompt:
41 A force acting on a moving body along the direction of its velocity changes:
(Harkat karte jism par us ki velocity ke rukh mein lagne wali force kya badalti hai?)

options.text: sirf speed, simt wohi rehti hai
sirf simt, speed wohi rehti hai

blocks.explanation: Velocity ke rukh mein force sirf speed badalti hai, simt wohi rehti hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: A force acting on a moving body along the direction of its velocity will change magnitude of the velocity (speed) keeping the direction unchanged.

blocks.prompt:
42 A constant force acting perpendicular to the velocity of a body moving in a circle:
(Gol raaste par chalte jism ki velocity par amoodi lagne wali constant force:)

options.text: simt badalti hai, speed wohi rehti hai

blocks.explanation: Velocity par amoodi force simt badalti hai jab ke speed wohi rehti hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: a constant force acting perpendicular to the velocity of a body moving in a circular path will change the direction

blocks.prompt:
43 The force needed to bend the straight path of a particle into a circular path is called:
(Particle ke seedhe raaste ko gol raaste mein morne ke liye zaroori force kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Seedhe raaste ko gol banane wali force centripetal (markaz-joo) force hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: The force needed to bend the straight path of the particle into a circular path is called the centripetal force.

blocks.prompt:
44 The direction of the centripetal force on a body moving in a circle is:
(Gol raaste par chalte jism par centripetal force ki simt kya hoti hai?)

options.text: radius ke saath markaz ki taraf
radius ke saath markaz se door

blocks.explanation: Centripetal force radius ke saath hamesha jism ko markaz ki taraf kheenchti hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: This force always pulls the object towards the centre of the circular path.

blocks.prompt:
45 The angle between the centripetal force and the tangential velocity at any point of a circular path is:
(Gol raaste ke kisi point par centripetal force aur tangential velocity ke darmiyan angle kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Centripetal force har point par tangential velocity par amoodi (90°) hoti hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: Its direction is perpendicular to the tangential velocity at each point.

blocks.prompt:
46 A ball is whirled in a horizontal circle by a string. If the string snaps when the ball is at point A, the ball moves:
(Aik gend dhaage se ufuqi circle mein ghumayi jati hai. Agar point A par dhaaga toot jaye to gend:)

options.text: radius ke saath markaz ki taraf
A par circle ke tangent ke saath
radius ke saath markaz se door

blocks.explanation: Agar A par dhaaga toot jaye to gend seedhi line AB, yani A par tangent ke saath chalti hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: the ball will follow the straight line path AB which is tangent AB at point A

blocks.prompt:
47 A 0.50 kg stone moves at 4.0 m s⁻¹ in a circle of radius 2.0 m. The centripetal force on it is:
(0.50 kg ka pathar 2.0 m radius ke circle mein 4.0 m s⁻¹ se chalta hai. Us par centripetal force kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: For a body of mass m moving with velocity v in a circular path of radius r

blocks.prompt:
48 A car moves at 20 m s⁻¹ on a circular track of radius 50 m. Its centripetal acceleration is:
(Aik car 50 m radius ke gol track par 20 m s⁻¹ se chalti hai. Us ki centripetal acceleration kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: a꜀ = v²/r = 400/50 = 8.0 m s⁻², markaz ki taraf (3.2).

book_ref.quote: is the centripetal acceleration and its direction is towards the centre of the circle

blocks.prompt:
49 A 0.20 kg body moves in a circle of radius 0.50 m with angular velocity 10 rad s⁻¹. The centripetal force is:
(0.20 kg ka jism 0.50 m radius ke circle mein 10 rad s⁻¹ ki angular velocity se chalta hai. Centripetal force kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: As v = rω, so the above equation becomes:

blocks.prompt:
50 If the speed of a body moving in a circle of fixed radius is doubled, the centripetal force needed becomes:
(Agar fixed radius ke circle mein chalte jism ki speed dugni kar di jaye to zaroori centripetal force:)
blocks.explanation: F꜀ = mv²/r; v dugna karne se v² chaar guna, is liye F꜀ chaar guna (Eq. 3.12).

book_ref.quote: Such force makes the body move in a circle by producing a radial (or centripetal) acceleration

blocks.prompt:
51 For the same mass and speed, if the radius of the circular path is doubled, the centripetal force becomes:
(Wohi mass aur speed rakhte hue agar gol raaste ka radius dugna kar diya jaye to centripetal force:)
blocks.explanation: Wohi m aur v par F꜀ = mv²/r, r ke ulat mutanasib hai, is liye aadhi ho jati hai (Eq. 3.12).

book_ref.quote: Thus, a force is needed to change the direction of velocity or motion of a body continuously

blocks.prompt:
52 A disc spins at 300 rpm. Its frequency of rotation is:
(Aik disc 300 rpm par ghoomti hai. Us ki frequency kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: f = 300/60 = 5.0 rev/s = 5.0 Hz (Example 3.2 ka tareeqa).

book_ref.quote: We convert 210 rpm into a frequency in revolutions per second (Hz).

blocks.prompt:
53 A disc of diameter 10 cm spins at 300 rpm. The radial acceleration of a point on its rim is about:
(10 cm diameter ki disc 300 rpm par ghoomti hai. Us ke kinare ke point ki radial acceleration taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: f = 5.0 Hz, ω = 2πf = 10π rad s⁻¹; a = ω²r = (10π)² × 0.050 = 49 m s⁻².

book_ref.quote: what is the radial acceleration of a point on the outer rim of the CD

blocks.prompt:
54 A ball is swung in a vertical circle. At the top point, the required centripetal force is provided by:
(Aik gend vertical circle mein ghumayi jati hai. Sab se oopar wale point par zaroori centripetal force kaun deta hai?)

options.text: dhaage ka tension aur gend ka wazan mil kar

blocks.explanation: Oopar A par dhaage ka khinchao T aur wazan w dono radius ke saath hain; T + w = mv²/r (Example 3.3).

book_ref.quote: These forces act along the radius at A, and so their vector sum must furnish the required centripetal force.

blocks.prompt:
55 A 0.10 kg ball moves at 3.0 m s⁻¹ at the top of a vertical circle of radius 0.50 m. The tension in the string there is (g = 9.8 m s⁻²):
(0.10 kg ki gend 0.50 m radius ke vertical circle ke sab se oopar 3.0 m s⁻¹ se hai. Wahan dhaage ka tension kitna hai (g = 9.8 m s⁻²)?)

book_ref.quote: two forces act on the ball, the pull of the string and the weight w of the ball

blocks.prompt:
56 At the top of a vertical circle the tension in the string becomes zero when:
(Vertical circle ke sab se oopar dhaage ka tension kab sifr hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: T = m(v²/r − g); agar v²/r = g ho to T = 0 aur sirf wazan centripetal force deta hai (Example 3.3).

book_ref.quote: then T will be zero and the centripetal force is just equal to the weight

blocks.prompt:
57 The speed at the top of a vertical circle of radius 0.90 m at which the string just goes slack (T = 0) is about (g = 9.8 m s⁻²):
(0.90 m radius ke vertical circle ke oopar kis speed par dhaaga bilkul dheela (T = 0) hota hai (g = 9.8 m s⁻²)?)
blocks.explanation: T = 0 jab v²/r = g; v = √(gr) = √8.82 = 3.0 m s⁻¹ (Example 3.3).

book_ref.quote: is swung in a vertical circle of radius r under the action of gravity

blocks.prompt:
58 Curved flight of aeroplanes at high speed is dangerous because it requires:
(Tez raftaar par jahaz ki murti hui parwaaz khatarnaak kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tez raftaar par murne ke liye bari centripetal force chahiye (F꜀ = mv²/r), is liye yeh khatarnaak hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: Curved flight at high speed requires a large centripetal force

blocks.prompt:
59 When a ball is whirled in a horizontal circle by a string, the centripetal force is provided by:
(Jab gend ko dhaage se ufuqi circle mein ghumaya jaye to centripetal force kaun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dhaage ka tension (khinchao) zaroori centripetal force deta hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: tension in the string provides necessary centripetal force

blocks.prompt:
60 For a coin placed on a rotating turntable, the centripetal force is provided by:
(Ghoomte turntable par rakhe sikke ke liye centripetal force kaun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Turntable par rakhi cheez ke liye friction (ragar) hi centripetal force hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: For an object placed on a turntable, the friction is the centripetal force.

blocks.prompt:
61 The centripetal force that keeps the Moon and artificial satellites revolving around the Earth is:
(Chaand aur masnooi satellites ko Zameen ke gird ghumane wali centripetal force kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gravitational force (kashish-e-saql) hi Chaand aur satellites ko Zameen ke gird ghumati hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: The gravitational force is the cause of the Earth orbiting around the Sun

blocks.prompt:
62 A charged particle moving in a straight line is made to move in a circle by:
(Seedhi line mein chalte charged particle ko circle mein kaun chalata hai?)

options.text: us ki velocity ke rukh mein force

blocks.explanation: Amoodi magnetic force charged particle ko gol raaste par chalati hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: A normal or perpendicular magnetic force compels a charge particle moving along a straight path into a circular path.

blocks.prompt:
63 A 1000 kg car takes a turn of radius 50 m at 15 m s⁻¹ on a level road. The friction force needed between the tyres and the road is:
(1000 kg ki car hamwaar sarak par 50 m radius ka mor 15 m s⁻¹ se leti hai. Tyres aur sarak ke darmiyan kitni friction chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Friction hi centripetal force hai: F꜀ = mv²/r = 1000 × 225/50 = 4500 N (Eq. 3.12).

book_ref.quote: which is provided by the friction between the tyres and the road

blocks.prompt:
64 On a banked road at a turn:
(Mor par banked (dhalwaan) sarak mein:)

options.text: bahar wala kinara andar wale se thora ooncha
andar wala kinara bahar wale se ooncha
sarak zyada phisalwaan banayi jati hai
